content: Physiotherapy, also known as physical therapy, is a healthcare profession focused on the assessment, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of physical impairments, disabilities, and pain caused by injury, illness, or aging. It involves the use of physical methods such as exercise, manual therapy, education, and modalities like heat, cold, and electrical stimulation to help restore movement, improve function, reduce pain, and promote overall health and well-being. Physiotherapists work with individuals of all ages to help them recover from injuries, manage chronic conditions, and enhance their physical performance.
